crossRefs.keyword: probably a proverbial expression for a small space

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

translations.web: That first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armor bearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were half a furrow’s length in an acre of land.
translations.bsb: In that first assault, Jonathan and his armor-bearer struck down about twenty men in about half an acre of land.
translations.kjv: And that first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armourbearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were an half acre of land, which a yoke of oxen might plow.
translations.asv: And that first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armorbearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were half a furrow's length in an acre of land.
